chosen: The 3:1 LTV:CPA ratio framework: teach owners to calculate customer lifetime value against cost-per-acquisition and use the ratio to decide whether to fix follow-up/retention before scaling ad spend
rejected: Ad creative fatigue signal framework (already shipped)

chosen: Missed-call text-back often triggers after the voicemail cycle ends instead of on the miss itself, quietly adding 20-30 seconds before the lead sees a response; teach owners to test the delay with an outside caller and ask their provider to switch the trigger
rejected: Missed-call text-back eligibility filters (opt-outs, dedupe, spam exclusion) — too technical/config-heavy for a one-week owner action
2026 Instagram Reels best-practice recap — platform-generic, not a niche revenue tactic
Google Business Profile 24-hour reply rule — already shipped angle

chosen: The Coverage Math framework: hours open ÷ 168 reveals what share of the week a business can live-answer a lead, mapped to the automated-coverage fix.
rejected: Two-pipeline model separating new-lead conversion from customer reactivation (overlaps prior retention/reactivation frameworks)
